ko.title: 연준이 가장 선호하는 인플레이션 지표: 대선 전 금리 결정에 PCE 보고서가 갖는 의미

segments.src: When people talk about inflation, they usually mean the Consumer Price Index, the monthly report that makes headlines and shows up in everyday conversation.
segments.tr: 사람들이 인플레이션에 대해 이야기할 때, 보통은 헤드라인을 장식하고 일상적인 대화에 등장하는 월간 보고서인 소비자물가지수(CPI)를 의미합니다.

segments.src: But the Federal Reserve's official 2 percent inflation goal is defined in terms of a different measure: the **Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index**.
segments.tr: 하지만 연방준비제도(Fed)의 공식적인 2% 인플레이션 목표는 다른 지표인 **개인소비지출(PCE) 가격지수**를 기준으로 정의됩니다.

segments.src: With the next PCE reading due shortly after the Fed's latest rate decision, and with Election Day close behind, this is a good moment to understand what the number is, why policymakers prefer it, and how markets tend to interpret a surprise in either direction.
segments.tr: 다음 PCE 발표가 연준의 최근 금리 결정 직후에 예정되어 있고 대선일도 얼마 남지 않은 지금, 이 수치가 무엇인지, 왜 정책 입안자들이 이를 선호하는지, 그리고 시장이 양방향의 깜짝 결과에 어떻게 반응하는지 이해하기 좋은 시점입니다.

segments.src: *Note: Release dates and figures can change.
segments.tr: *참고: 발표 날짜와 수치는 변경될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Check the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) and Federal Reserve calendars for exact timing and the latest data.*
segments.tr: 정확한 일정과 최신 데이터는 미국 경제분석국(BEA) 및 연방준비제도 캘린더를 확인하세요.*

segments.src: ## What Is the PCE Price Index?
segments.tr: ## PCE 가격지수란 무엇인가?

segments.src: The PCE price index is published by the BEA, part of the U.S.
segments.tr: PCE 가격지수는 미국 상무부 산하

segments.src: Department of Commerce.
segments.tr: 경제분석국(BEA)에서 발표합니다.

segments.src: It tracks the prices of goods and services that households consume, and it is released alongside the monthly report on personal income and spending.
segments.tr: 이 지수는 가계가 소비하는 재화와 서비스의 가격을 추적하며, 개인 소득 및 지출에 관한 월간 보고서와 함께 발표됩니다.

segments.src: The Fed has used PCE inflation as its formal yardstick since 2012, when it set a long-run goal of 2 percent annual inflation.
segments.tr: 연준은 2012년 연간 인플레이션 목표치를 2%로 설정한 이후부터 PCE 인플레이션을 공식적인 척도로 사용해 왔습니다.

segments.src: In practice, the committee looks at many indicators, but PCE is the one its target is written around.
segments.tr: 실제로 위원회는 많은 지표를 살펴보지만, PCE는 목표치가 설정된 기준이 되는 지표입니다.

segments.src: ## How PCE Differs From CPI
segments.tr: ## PCE와 CPI의 차이점

segments.src: Both indexes measure price changes, but they are built differently.
segments.tr: 두 지수 모두 물가 변동을 측정하지만, 구성 방식은 다릅니다.

segments.src: Several differences matter:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 중요한 차이점이 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Scope.** CPI reflects out-of-pocket spending by urban consumers. PCE covers a broader range of spending, including purchases made on behalf of households, such as employer-paid health insurance and medical care covered by Medicare and Medicaid.
segments.tr: - **범위.** CPI는 도시 소비자의 직접적인 지출을 반영합니다. PCE는 고용주가 부담하는 건강 보험이나 메디케어(Medicare) 및 메디케이드(Medicaid)가 보장하는 의료 서비스와 같이 가계를 대신하여 이루어진 지출을 포함하여 더 광범위한 지출을 포괄합니다.

segments.src: - **Weights.** Housing makes up a larger share of CPI than of PCE. Because shelter costs often move slowly and can stay elevated, this difference can push the two measures apart.
segments.tr: - **가중치.** 주거비는 PCE보다 CPI에서 더 큰 비중을 차지합니다. 주거비는 종종 천천히 움직이고 높은 수준을 유지할 수 있기 때문에, 이러한 차이로 인해 두 지표 간의 격차가 발생할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Formula.** CPI is based on a fixed basket that is updated periodically. PCE uses a method that adjusts for the way consumers shift their spending when relative prices change. If beef gets expensive and shoppers buy more chicken, PCE captures that substitution more fully.
segments.tr: - **산출 방식.** CPI는 주기적으로 업데이트되는 고정된 바스켓을 기반으로 합니다. PCE는 상대 가격이 변할 때 소비자가 지출 방식을 바꾸는 것을 조정하는 방법을 사용합니다. 예를 들어 소고기 가격이 비싸져서 소비자들이 닭고기를 더 많이 구매하면, PCE는 이러한 대체 효과를 더 완전히 포착합니다.

segments.src: - **Revisions.** CPI is rarely revised after release. PCE can be revised, sometimes for several months and occasionally for years, as better source data arrive.
segments.tr: - **수정.** CPI는 발표 후 거의 수정되지 않습니다. 반면 PCE는 더 나은 원천 데이터가 입수됨에 따라 몇 달, 때로는 몇 년 동안 수정될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The result is that PCE inflation has often come in somewhat lower than CPI inflation over time, though the gap varies and can reverse.
segments.tr: 그 결과 PCE 인플레이션은 시간이 지남에 따라 CPI 인플레이션보다 다소 낮게 나타나는 경우가 많았지만, 그 격차는 변동하며 역전될 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why Core PCE Matters Most
segments.tr: ## 근원 PCE가 가장 중요한 이유

segments.src: Headline PCE includes everything, including food and energy.
segments.tr: 헤드라인 PCE는 식료품과 에너지를 포함한 모든 항목을 포함합니다.

segments.src: Those categories are volatile, driven by weather, geopolitics and supply disruptions that central banks cannot easily influence with interest rates.
segments.tr: 이러한 범주는 날씨, 지정학적 요인, 공급망 차질 등에 의해 변동성이 크며, 중앙은행이 금리로 쉽게 통제할 수 없습니다.

segments.src: **Core PCE** removes food and energy.
segments.tr: **근원 PCE(Core PCE)**는 식료품과 에너지를 제외합니다.

segments.src: Many policymakers view it as a cleaner signal of underlying inflation trends and a better guide to where overall inflation is heading over the next year or so.
segments.tr: 많은 정책 입안자들은 이를 근본적인 인플레이션 추세를 보여주는 더 명확한 신호이자 향후 1년 정도의 전반적인 인플레이션 향방을 가늠하는 더 나은 지표로 간주합니다.

segments.src: That is why you will often hear Fed officials emphasize the core figure in speeches and press conferences, even when the headline number gets the attention.
segments.tr: 이것이 바로 헤드라인 수치가 주목을 받을 때조차 연준 관계자들이 연설과 기자회견에서 근원 수치를 강조하는 이유입니다.

segments.src: Two other details are worth knowing:
segments.tr: 알아두어야 할 두 가지 세부 사항이 더 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Month-over-month readings** show momentum. A string of small monthly increases can add up to an annual rate well above target.
segments.tr: - **전월 대비 수치**는 모멘텀을 보여줍니다. 작은 월간 상승세가 지속되면 목표치를 훨씬 상회하는 연간 상승률로 이어질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Year-over-year readings** show the broader trend but can be distorted by what happened twelve months earlier, known as base effects.
segments.tr: - **전년 대비 수치**는 더 넓은 추세를 보여주지만, 12개월 전의 상황에 의해 왜곡될 수 있는데 이를 기저 효과라고 합니다.

segments.src: Some analysts also watch "supercore" inflation, which looks at services excluding housing, because it is closely tied to wages and labor market conditions.
segments.tr: 일부 분석가들은 임금 및 노동 시장 상황과 밀접하게 연관되어 있기 때문에 주거비를 제외한 서비스 물가를 나타내는 "슈퍼코어(supercore)" 인플레이션도 주시합니다.

segments.src: ## What a Hot or Cool Number Could Mean for Rates
segments.tr: ## 수치가 높거나 낮게 나올 경우 금리에 미칠 영향

segments.src: The Fed does not set policy based on one report.
segments.tr: 연준은 단 하나의 보고서에 기반하여 정책을 결정하지 않습니다.

segments.src: Still, each reading nudges expectations, and markets often react quickly.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 각 발표는 기대치를 변화시키며, 시장은 종종 빠르게 반응합니다.

segments.src: **A hotter-than-expected reading** could suggest that price pressures are proving stubborn.
segments.tr: **예상보다 높은 수치**는 물가 압력이 여전히 끈질기다는 것을 시사할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Possible effects include:
segments.tr: 가능한 영향은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - Greater caution among policymakers about cutting rates further, or a longer pause.
segments.tr: - 정책 입안자들이 추가 금리 인하에 대해 더 신중해지거나, 금리 인하를 더 오래 중단할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - Higher Treasury yields as investors scale back bets on near-term cuts.
segments.tr: - 투자자들이 단기 금리 인하에 대한 베팅을 축소함에 따라 국채 금리가 상승할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - A firmer U.S. dollar and, at times, pressure on rate-sensitive stocks such as technology and real estate.
segments.tr: - 미국 달러화가 강세를 보이고, 때로는 기술주나 부동산과 같이 금리에 민감한 주식에 압박이 가해질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **A cooler-than-expected reading** could strengthen the case that inflation is moving toward target.
segments.tr: **예상보다 낮은 수치**는 인플레이션이 목표치를 향해 가고 있다는 주장에 힘을 실어줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Possible effects include:
segments.tr: 가능한 영향은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - More room for the Fed to ease policy if the labor market is softening.
segments.tr: - 노동 시장이 둔화될 경우 연준이 정책을 완화할 여지가 더 커집니다.

segments.src: - Lower yields and, often, lower mortgage and borrowing rates over time.
segments.tr: - 시간이 지남에 따라 국채 금리가 낮아지고, 종종 주택 담보 대출 및 차입 금리도 낮아질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - A more supportive backdrop for stocks, particularly growth-oriented sectors.
segments.tr: - 주식 시장, 특히 성장주 중심 섹터에 더 우호적인 환경이 조성될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **An in-line reading** usually matters less for markets, but it can still shape the tone of Fed commentary.
segments.tr: **예상치에 부합하는 수치**는 시장에 미치는 영향이 적지만, 연준의 논평 기조를 형성할 수는 있습니다.

segments.src: Forecasts, known as consensus estimates, are what traders measure surprises against, so the gap between expectation and result is often more important than the number itself.
segments.tr: 컨센서스 추정치라고 불리는 전망치는 트레이더들이 깜짝 놀랄 만한 결과를 측정하는 기준이 되므로, 수치 자체보다는 기대치와 결과 사이의 격차가 더 중요한 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Timing Is Notable
segments.tr: ## 발표 시기가 중요한 이유

segments.src: The Fed's rate-setting committee meets on a published schedule, and the PCE report lands on its own calendar.
segments.tr: 연준의 금리 결정 위원회는 정해진 일정에 따라 회의를 열고, PCE 보고서는 별도의 일정에 따라 발표됩니다.

segments.src: When the data arrives just after a meeting, officials cannot react to it until their next gathering.
segments.tr: 데이터가 회의 직후에 나오면, 관계자들은 다음 회의 전까지는 이에 대응할 수 없습니다.

segments.src: Instead, it feeds into speeches, interviews and updated forecasts, and it can move market pricing for the following meeting.
segments.tr: 대신, 이 데이터는 연설, 인터뷰, 업데이트된 전망치에 반영되며 다음 회의에 대한 시장 가격을 움직일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The approach of Election Day adds another layer of attention, but the Fed is designed to operate independently and says it bases decisions on economic data and its dual mandate of maximum employment and stable prices.
segments.tr: 대선일이 다가오면서 관심이 더욱 집중되고 있지만, 연준은 독립적으로 운영되도록 설계되었으며 경제 데이터와 최대 고용 및 물가 안정이라는 이중 책무를 바탕으로 결정을 내린다고 밝히고 있습니다.

segments.src: Investors should be wary of assuming that policy follows the political calendar.
segments.tr: 투자자들은 정책이 정치적 일정에 따라 움직인다고 가정하는 것을 경계해야 합니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch When the Report Arrives
segments.tr: ## 보고서 발표 시 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: 1. **Core PCE, month over month.** Is momentum cooling or reaccelerating?
segments.tr: 1. **근원 PCE, 전월 대비.** 모멘텀이 둔화되고 있습니까, 아니면 다시 가속화되고 있습니까?

segments.src: 2. **Core PCE, year over year.** How far is it from the 2 percent goal?
segments.tr: 2. **근원 PCE, 전년 대비.** 2% 목표치에서 얼마나 떨어져 있습니까?

segments.src: 3. **Revisions to prior months.** Changes can alter the story of the past quarter.
segments.tr: 3. **이전 달 수치 수정.** 수정 사항은 지난 분기의 상황을 바꿀 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Services excluding housing.** A key gauge of labor-driven price pressure.
segments.tr: 4. **주거비를 제외한 서비스 물가.** 노동력에 의한 물가 압력을 보여주는 핵심 지표입니다.

segments.src: 5. **Personal income and spending.** Strong consumer demand can keep inflation elevated, while weakening spending may signal slowing growth.
segments.tr: 5. **개인 소득 및 지출.** 강력한 소비자 수요는 인플레이션을 높은 수준으로 유지할 수 있는 반면, 지출 감소는 성장 둔화를 시사할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 6. **Fed speakers.** Their reaction in the days after the release often clarifies how the committee reads the data.
segments.tr: 6. **연준 인사들의 발언.** 발표 후 며칠 동안의 그들의 반응은 위원회가 데이터를 어떻게 해석하는지를 명확히 보여줍니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: CPI may dominate the headlines, but PCE, and especially core PCE, is the measure closest to the Fed's decision-making.
segments.tr: CPI가 헤드라인을 장식할지 모르지만, PCE, 특히 근원 PCE는 연준의 의사결정에 가장 가까운 지표입니다.

segments.src: Understanding how it is built, and why it can differ from CPI, helps you read market reactions with more context.
segments.tr: PCE가 어떻게 구성되는지, 그리고 왜 CPI와 다를 수 있는지 이해하면 더 많은 맥락을 가지고 시장 반응을 읽는 데 도움이 됩니다.

segments.src: A surprise in either direction will shift expectations for interest rates, but one report is rarely decisive.
segments.tr: 어느 방향으로든 깜짝 결과가 나오면 금리에 대한 기대치가 바뀔 수 있지만, 단 하나의 보고서가 결정적인 경우는 거의 없습니다.

segments.src: The trend across several months tells the more reliable story.
segments.tr: 수개월에 걸친 추세가 더 신뢰할 수 있는 이야기를 들려줍니다.

segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공 목적으로만 작성되었으며 투자, 재무 또는 세무 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Economic data and forecasts are subject to revision, and past market reactions do not guarantee future results.
segments.tr: 경제 데이터와 전망치는 수정될 수 있으며, 과거의 시장 반응이 미래의 결과를 보장하지 않습니다.

segments.tr: 재무적 결정을 내리기 전에 자격을 갖춘 전문가와 상담하십시오.*

zh.title: 美联储最青睐的通胀指标：PCE报告对大选日前利率意味着什么

segments.src: When people talk about inflation, they usually mean the Consumer Price Index, the monthly report that makes headlines and shows up in everyday conversation.
segments.tr: 当人们谈论通胀时，通常指的是消费者物价指数（CPI），这是每月都会登上头条并在日常对话中出现的报告。

segments.src: But the Federal Reserve's official 2 percent inflation goal is defined in terms of a different measure: the **Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index**.
segments.tr: 但美联储官方设定的 2% 通胀目标是通过另一个指标来定义的：**个人消费支出（PCE）物价指数**。

segments.src: With the next PCE reading due shortly after the Fed's latest rate decision, and with Election Day close behind, this is a good moment to understand what the number is, why policymakers prefer it, and how markets tend to interpret a surprise in either direction.
segments.tr: 随着下一次 PCE 数据的发布恰逢美联储最新利率决议之后不久，且大选日紧随其后，现在正是理解这一数字是什么、为什么政策制定者更青睐它以及市场如何解读任何方向的意外的好时机。

segments.src: *Note: Release dates and figures can change.
segments.tr: *注：发布日期和数据可能会有变动。

segments.src: Check the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) and Federal Reserve calendars for exact timing and the latest data.*
segments.tr: 请查看经济分析局（BEA）和美联储的日历以获取准确时间和最新数据.*

segments.src: ## What Is the PCE Price Index?
segments.tr: ## 什么是 PCE 物价指数？

segments.src: The PCE price index is published by the BEA, part of the U.S.
segments.tr: PCE 物价指数由美国商务部下属的经济分析局（BEA）发布。

segments.src: Department of Commerce.
segments.tr: 商务部。

segments.src: It tracks the prices of goods and services that households consume, and it is released alongside the monthly report on personal income and spending.
segments.tr: 它追踪家庭消费的商品和服务价格，与关于个人收入和支出的月度报告一同发布。

segments.src: The Fed has used PCE inflation as its formal yardstick since 2012, when it set a long-run goal of 2 percent annual inflation.
segments.tr: 自 2012 年设定长期年通胀目标为 2% 以来，美联储一直将 PCE 通胀作为其官方衡量标准。

segments.src: In practice, the committee looks at many indicators, but PCE is the one its target is written around.
segments.tr: 在实践中，委员会会参考许多指标，但 PCE 是其目标围绕制定的指标。

segments.src: ## How PCE Differs From CPI
segments.tr: ## PCE 与 CPI 的区别

segments.src: Both indexes measure price changes, but they are built differently.
segments.tr: 这两个指数都衡量价格变动，但它们的构建方式不同。

segments.src: Several differences matter:
segments.tr: 有几个重要的区别：

segments.src: - **Scope.** CPI reflects out-of-pocket spending by urban consumers. PCE covers a broader range of spending, including purchases made on behalf of households, such as employer-paid health insurance and medical care covered by Medicare and Medicaid.
segments.tr: - **范围。** CPI 反映城市消费者的自掏腰包支出。PCE 涵盖更广泛的支出，包括代表家庭进行的采购，例如雇主支付的医疗保险以及由联邦医疗保险（Medicare）和医疗补助（Medicaid）支付的医疗护理。

segments.src: - **Weights.** Housing makes up a larger share of CPI than of PCE. Because shelter costs often move slowly and can stay elevated, this difference can push the two measures apart.
segments.tr: - **权重。** 住房在 CPI 中占比较大，而在 PCE 中占比较小。由于住房成本往往变动缓慢且可能保持高位，这种差异会拉开这两个指标的差距。

segments.src: - **Formula.** CPI is based on a fixed basket that is updated periodically. PCE uses a method that adjusts for the way consumers shift their spending when relative prices change. If beef gets expensive and shoppers buy more chicken, PCE captures that substitution more fully.
segments.tr: - **公式。** CPI 基于定期更新的固定一篮子商品。PCE 采用了一种根据相对价格变化时消费者改变其支出方式进行调整的方法。如果牛肉变贵了，购物者买更多的鸡肉，PCE 能更全面地捕捉到这种替代效应。

segments.src: - **Revisions.** CPI is rarely revised after release. PCE can be revised, sometimes for several months and occasionally for years, as better source data arrive.
segments.tr: - **修正。** CPI 在发布后很少被修正。随着更好的源数据到达，PCE 可能会被修正，有时持续几个月，偶尔甚至持续几年。

segments.src: The result is that PCE inflation has often come in somewhat lower than CPI inflation over time, though the gap varies and can reverse.
segments.tr: 结果是，随着时间推移，PCE 通胀往往比 CPI 通胀略低，尽管差距会变化并且可能会逆转。

segments.src: ## Why Core PCE Matters Most
segments.tr: ## 为什么核心 PCE 最重要

segments.src: Headline PCE includes everything, including food and energy.
segments.tr: 整体 PCE 包含一切，包括食品和能源。

segments.src: Those categories are volatile, driven by weather, geopolitics and supply disruptions that central banks cannot easily influence with interest rates.
segments.tr: 这些类别波动较大，受天气、地缘政治和供应链中断驱动，中央银行无法通过利率轻松对其施加影响。

segments.src: **Core PCE** removes food and energy.
segments.tr: **核心 PCE** 剔除了食品和能源。

segments.src: Many policymakers view it as a cleaner signal of underlying inflation trends and a better guide to where overall inflation is heading over the next year or so.
segments.tr: 许多政策制定者认为它是潜在通胀趋势的更清晰信号，也是未来一年左右整体通胀走向的更好指南。

segments.src: That is why you will often hear Fed officials emphasize the core figure in speeches and press conferences, even when the headline number gets the attention.
segments.tr: 这就是为什么你经常会听到美联储官员在演讲和新闻发布会上强调核心数据，即使整体数据获得了更多关注。

segments.src: Two other details are worth knowing:
segments.tr: 还有两个细节值得了解：

segments.src: - **Month-over-month readings** show momentum. A string of small monthly increases can add up to an annual rate well above target.
segments.tr: - **环比数据**显示了动能。一连串的小幅月度增长可能会累积成远超目标的年化率。

segments.src: - **Year-over-year readings** show the broader trend but can be distorted by what happened twelve months earlier, known as base effects.
segments.tr: - **同比数据**显示了更广泛的趋势，但可能会被十二个月前发生的事情（称为基数效应）所扭曲。

segments.src: Some analysts also watch "supercore" inflation, which looks at services excluding housing, because it is closely tied to wages and labor market conditions.
segments.tr: 一些分析师还关注“超级核心”通胀，它着眼于剔除住房的服务业，因为它与工资和劳动力市场状况紧密相连。

segments.src: ## What a Hot or Cool Number Could Mean for Rates
segments.tr: ## 数据偏高或偏低对利率意味着什么

segments.src: The Fed does not set policy based on one report.
segments.tr: 美联储不会根据一份报告来制定政策。

segments.src: Still, each reading nudges expectations, and markets often react quickly.
segments.tr: 尽管如此，每一项数据都会微调预期，市场通常会做出迅速反应。

segments.src: **A hotter-than-expected reading** could suggest that price pressures are proving stubborn.
segments.tr: **高于预期的读数**可能表明价格压力正在证明是顽固的。

segments.src: Possible effects include:
segments.tr: 可能的影响包括：

segments.src: - Greater caution among policymakers about cutting rates further, or a longer pause.
segments.tr: - 政策制定者对进一步降息持更大谨慎态度，或者暂停更长时间。

segments.src: - Higher Treasury yields as investors scale back bets on near-term cuts.
segments.tr: - 随着投资者缩减对近期降息的押注，美国国债收益率上升。

segments.src: - A firmer U.S. dollar and, at times, pressure on rate-sensitive stocks such as technology and real estate.
segments.tr: - 美元走强，有时对科技股和房地产等利率敏感型股票施加压力。

segments.src: **A cooler-than-expected reading** could strengthen the case that inflation is moving toward target.
segments.tr: **低于预期的读数**可能会强化通胀正朝着目标迈进的观点。

segments.src: Possible effects include:
segments.tr: 可能的影响包括：

segments.src: - More room for the Fed to ease policy if the labor market is softening.
segments.tr: - 如果劳动力市场正在走软，美联储有更多空间来宽松政策。

segments.src: - Lower yields and, often, lower mortgage and borrowing rates over time.
segments.tr: - 随着时间推移，收益率降低，通常按揭贷款和借贷利率也会降低。

segments.src: - A more supportive backdrop for stocks, particularly growth-oriented sectors.
segments.tr: - 对股票更具支持性的背景，特别是注重增长的板块。

segments.src: **An in-line reading** usually matters less for markets, but it can still shape the tone of Fed commentary.
segments.tr: **符合预期的读数**对市场通常没那么重要，但它仍然可以塑造美联储评论的基调。

segments.src: Forecasts, known as consensus estimates, are what traders measure surprises against, so the gap between expectation and result is often more important than the number itself.
segments.tr: 被称为共识预测的预测是交易员衡量意外的基准，因此期望与结果之间的差距通常比数字本身更重要。

segments.src: ## Why the Timing Is Notable
segments.tr: ## 为什么时间点值得关注

segments.src: The Fed's rate-setting committee meets on a published schedule, and the PCE report lands on its own calendar.
segments.tr: 美联储的利率设定委员会按照公布的日程开会，而 PCE 报告也有其自己的日历。

segments.src: When the data arrives just after a meeting, officials cannot react to it until their next gathering.
segments.tr: 当数据在会议刚结束后到达时，官员们无法在下次聚会之前对做出反应。

segments.src: Instead, it feeds into speeches, interviews and updated forecasts, and it can move market pricing for the following meeting.
segments.tr: 相反，它会被纳入演讲、采访和更新的预测中，并且可以动摇下一次会议的市场定价。

segments.src: The approach of Election Day adds another layer of attention, but the Fed is designed to operate independently and says it bases decisions on economic data and its dual mandate of maximum employment and stable prices.
segments.tr: 大选日的临近增添了另一层关注，但美联储旨在独立运作，并表示其决策基于经济数据以及最大就业和稳定价格的双重使命。

segments.src: Investors should be wary of assuming that policy follows the political calendar.
segments.tr: 投资者应警惕假设政策遵循政治日历。

segments.src: ## What to Watch When the Report Arrives
segments.tr: ## 报告到达时应关注什么

segments.src: 1. **Core PCE, month over month.** Is momentum cooling or reaccelerating?
segments.tr: 1. **核心 PCE，环比。** 动能是在冷却还是重新加速？

segments.src: 2. **Core PCE, year over year.** How far is it from the 2 percent goal?
segments.tr: 2. **核心 PCE，同比。** 距离 2% 的目标还有多远？

segments.src: 3. **Revisions to prior months.** Changes can alter the story of the past quarter.
segments.tr: 3. **对前几个月的修正。** 变化可能会改变过去季度的故事。

segments.src: 4. **Services excluding housing.** A key gauge of labor-driven price pressure.
segments.tr: 4. **剔除住房的服务业。** 劳动力驱动的价格压力的关键指标。

segments.src: 5. **Personal income and spending.** Strong consumer demand can keep inflation elevated, while weakening spending may signal slowing growth.
segments.tr: 5. **个人收入和支出。** 强劲的消费者需求可能会使通胀保持高位，而减弱的支出可能标志着增长放缓。

segments.src: 6. **Fed speakers.** Their reaction in the days after the release often clarifies how the committee reads the data.
segments.tr: 6. **美联储发言人。** 他们在发布后几天的反应通常会澄清委员会如何解读数据。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: CPI may dominate the headlines, but PCE, and especially core PCE, is the measure closest to the Fed's decision-making.
segments.tr: CPI 可能占据头条，但 PCE，尤其是核心 PCE，是距离美联储决策最近的指标。

segments.src: Understanding how it is built, and why it can differ from CPI, helps you read market reactions with more context.
segments.tr: 理解它是如何构建的，以及为什么它可能与 CPI 不同，有助于你以更多的背景信息来阅读市场反应。

segments.src: A surprise in either direction will shift expectations for interest rates, but one report is rarely decisive.
segments.tr: 任何方向的意外都会改变对利率的预期，但一份报告很少具有决定性。

segments.src: The trend across several months tells the more reliable story.
segments.tr: 几个月以来的趋势讲述了更可靠的故事。

segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考之用，并非投资、财务或税务建议。

segments.src: Economic data and forecasts are subject to revision, and past market reactions do not guarantee future results.
segments.tr: 经济数据和预测可能会进行修正，过去的市场反应并不保证未来的结果。

segments.src: Consider consulting a qualified professional before making financial decisions.*
segments.tr: 在做出财务决策之前，请考虑咨询合格的专业人士。*

segments.tr: जब लोग मुद्रास्फीति के बारे में बात करते हैं, तो उनका अक्सर मतलब उपभोक्ता मूल्य सूचकांक (CPI) से होता है, वह मासिक रिपोर्ट जो सुर्खियों में रहती है और रोजमर्रा की बातचीत में दिखाई देती है।

segments.src: But the Federal Reserve's official 2 percent inflation goal is defined in terms of a different measure: the **Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index**.

segments.src: ## What Is the PCE Price Index?
segments.tr: ## PCE मूल्य सूचकांक क्या है?

segments.src: The PCE price index is published by the BEA, part of the U.S.
segments.tr: PCE मूल्य सूचकांक BEA द्वारा प्रकाशित किया जाता है, जो अमेरिकी वाणिज्य विभाग का हिस्सा है।

segments.src: Department of Commerce.
It tracks the prices of goods and services that households consume, and it is released alongside the monthly report on personal income and spending.
segments.tr: यह उन वस्तुओं और सेवाओं की कीमतों पर नज़र रखता है जिनका उपयोग घर करते हैं, और इसे व्यक्तिगत आय और व्यय पर मासिक रिपोर्ट के साथ जारी किया जाता है।

segments.src: The Fed has used PCE inflation as its formal yardstick since 2012, when it set a long-run goal of 2 percent annual inflation.
segments.tr: फेड ने 2012 से PCE मुद्रास्फीति का उपयोग अपने औपचारिक मानदंड के रूप में किया है, जब उसने 2 प्रतिशत वार्षिक मुद्रास्फीति का दीर्घकालिक लक्ष्य निर्धारित किया था।

segments.src: In practice, the committee looks at many indicators, but PCE is the one its target is written around.
segments.tr: व्यवहार में, समिति कई संकेतकों को देखती है, लेकिन PCE वह मापक है जिसके इर्द-गिर्द उसका लक्ष्य लिखा गया है।

segments.src: ## How PCE Differs From CPI
segments.tr: ## PCE, CPI से कैसे भिन्न है

segments.src: Both indexes measure price changes, but they are built differently.
segments.tr: दोनों सूचकांक मूल्य परिवर्तनों को मापते हैं, लेकिन वे अलग-अलग तरीके से बनाए गए हैं।

segments.src: Several differences matter:
segments.tr: कई अंतर मायने रखते हैं:

segments.src: - **Scope.** CPI reflects out-of-pocket spending by urban consumers. PCE covers a broader range of spending, including purchases made on behalf of households, such as employer-paid health insurance and medical care covered by Medicare and Medicaid.
segments.tr: - **दायरा (Scope)।** CPI शहरी उपभोक्ताओं द्वारा किए गए जेब के खर्च को दर्शाता है। PCE खर्च की एक विस्तृत श्रृंखला को कवर करता है, जिसमें घरों की ओर से की गई खरीदारी भी शामिल है, जैसे नियोक्ता-भुगतान स्वास्थ्य बीमा और मेडिकेयर और मेडिकेयड द्वारा कवर की जाने वाली चिकित्सा देखभाल।

segments.src: - **Weights.** Housing makes up a larger share of CPI than of PCE. Because shelter costs often move slowly and can stay elevated, this difference can push the two measures apart.
segments.tr: - **भार (Weights)।** आवास (Housing) PCE की तुलना में CPI का एक बड़ा हिस्सा बनता है। चूंकि आवास लागत अक्सर धीरे-धीरे बदलती है और ऊंची बनी रह सकती है, यह अंतर दोनों मापकों को अलग कर सकता है।

segments.src: - **Formula.** CPI is based on a fixed basket that is updated periodically. PCE uses a method that adjusts for the way consumers shift their spending when relative prices change. If beef gets expensive and shoppers buy more chicken, PCE captures that substitution more fully.
segments.tr: - **फॉर्मूला।** CPI एक निश्चित बास्केट पर आधारित है जिसे समय-समय पर अपडेट किया जाता है। PCE एक ऐसी विधि का उपयोग करता है जो सापेक्ष मूल्य बदलने पर उपभोक्ताओं द्वारा अपने खर्च को बदलने के तरीके को समायोजित करती है। यदि बीफ महंगा हो जाता है और खरीदार अधिक चिकन खरीदते हैं, तो PCE उस प्रतिस्थापन को अधिक पूरी तरह से पकड़ता है।

segments.src: - **Revisions.** CPI is rarely revised after release. PCE can be revised, sometimes for several months and occasionally for years, as better source data arrive.
segments.tr: - **संशोधन (Revisions)।** जारी होने के बाद CPI में शायद ही कभी संशोधन किया जाता है। बेहतर स्रोत डेटा आने पर PCE को संशोधित किया जा सकता है, कभी-कभी कई महीनों के लिए और कभी-कभी वर्षों के लिए।

segments.src: The result is that PCE inflation has often come in somewhat lower than CPI inflation over time, though the gap varies and can reverse.
segments.tr: परिणाम यह है कि PCE मुद्रास्फीति समय के साथ CPI मुद्रास्फीति की तुलना में अक्सर कुछ कम रही है, हालांकि यह अंतर भिन्न होता है और उलट भी सकता है।

segments.src: ## Why Core PCE Matters Most
segments.tr: ## कोर PCE सबसे अधिक क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: Headline PCE includes everything, including food and energy.
segments.tr: हेडलाइन PCE में भोजन और ऊर्जा सहित सब कुछ शामिल है।

segments.src: Those categories are volatile, driven by weather, geopolitics and supply disruptions that central banks cannot easily influence with interest rates.
segments.tr: वे श्रेणियां अस्थिर हैं, जो मौसम, भू-राजनीति और आपूर्ति में रुकावटों से संचालित होती हैं जिन्हें केंद्रीय बैंक ब्याज दरों के साथ आसानी से प्रभावित नहीं कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: **Core PCE** removes food and energy.
segments.tr: **कोर PCE** भोजन और ऊर्जा को हटा देता है।

segments.src: Many policymakers view it as a cleaner signal of underlying inflation trends and a better guide to where overall inflation is heading over the next year or so.
segments.tr: कई नीति निर्माता इसे अंतर्निहित मुद्रास्फीति के रुझानों के एक स्पष्ट संकेत के रूप में देखते हैं और अगले एक वर्ष में कुल मुद्रास्फीति किस ओर जा रही है, इसका एक बेहतर मार्गदर्शक मानते हैं।

segments.src: That is why you will often hear Fed officials emphasize the core figure in speeches and press conferences, even when the headline number gets the attention.
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि आप अक्सर फेड अधिकारियों को भाषणों और प्रेस कॉन्फ्रेंस में कोर आंकड़े पर जोर देते हुए सुनेंगे, भले ही हेडलाइन नंबर पर ध्यान दिया जाता हो।

segments.src: Two other details are worth knowing:
segments.tr: दो अन्य विवरण जानने योग्य हैं:

segments.src: - **Month-over-month readings** show momentum. A string of small monthly increases can add up to an annual rate well above target.
segments.tr: - **महीने-दर-महीने (Month-over-month) की रीडिंग** गति (momentum) को दर्शाती है। छोटी मासिक वृद्धि की एक श्रृंखला लक्ष्य से काफी ऊपर वार्षिक दर तक जुड़ सकती है।

segments.src: - **Year-over-year readings** show the broader trend but can be distorted by what happened twelve months earlier, known as base effects.
segments.tr: - **साल-दर-साल (Year-over-year) की रीडिंग** व्यापक रुझान दिखाती है, लेकिन बारह महीने पहले क्या हुआ था, जिसे बेस इफेक्ट के रूप में जाना जाता है, उससे विकृत हो सकती है।

segments.src: Some analysts also watch "supercore" inflation, which looks at services excluding housing, because it is closely tied to wages and labor market conditions.
segments.tr: कुछ विश्लेषक "सुपरकोर" मुद्रास्फीति पर भी नज़र रखते हैं, जो आवास को छोड़कर सेवाओं को देखता है, क्योंकि यह मजदूरी और श्रम बाजार की स्थितियों से निकटता से जुड़ा हुआ है।

segments.src: ## What a Hot or Cool Number Could Mean for Rates
segments.tr: ## गर्म या ठंडे आंकड़े का दरों के लिए क्या अर्थ हो सकता है

segments.src: The Fed does not set policy based on one report.
segments.tr: फेड एक रिपोर्ट के आधार पर नीति निर्धारित नहीं करता है।

segments.src: Still, each reading nudges expectations, and markets often react quickly.
segments.tr: फिर भी, प्रत्येक रीडिंग अपेक्षाओं को थोड़ा प्रभावित करती है, और बाजार अक्सर जल्दी प्रतिक्रिया करते हैं।

segments.src: **A hotter-than-expected reading** could suggest that price pressures are proving stubborn.
segments.tr: **उम्मीद से अधिक गर्म (अधिक) रीडिंग** यह सुझाव दे सकती है कि मूल्य दबाव जिद्दी साबित हो रहे हैं।

segments.src: Possible effects include:
segments.tr: संभावित प्रभावों में शामिल हैं:

segments.src: - Greater caution among policymakers about cutting rates further, or a longer pause.
segments.tr: - नीति निर्माताओं के बीच दरों में और कटौती करने के बारे में अधिक सावधानी, या एक लंबा विराम।

segments.src: - Higher Treasury yields as investors scale back bets on near-term cuts.
segments.tr: - ट्रेजरी यील्ड में बढ़ोतरी क्योंकि निवेशक निकट अवधि की कटौती पर दांव कम कर देते हैं।

segments.src: - A firmer U.S. dollar and, at times, pressure on rate-sensitive stocks such as technology and real estate.
segments.tr: - एक मजबूत अमेरिकी डॉलर और, कई बार, प्रौद्योगिकी और रियल एस्टेट जैसे दर-संवेदनशील शेयरों पर दबाव।

segments.src: **A cooler-than-expected reading** could strengthen the case that inflation is moving toward target.
segments.tr: **उम्मीद से अधिक ठंडी (कम) रीडिंग** इस तर्क को मजबूत कर सकती है कि मुद्रास्फीति लक्ष्य की ओर बढ़ रही है।

segments.src: Possible effects include:
segments.tr: संभावित प्रभावों में शामिल हैं:

segments.src: - More room for the Fed to ease policy if the labor market is softening.
segments.tr: - यदि श्रम बाजार नरम हो रहा है तो फेड के लिए नीति को आसान बनाने की अधिक गुंजाइश।

segments.src: - Lower yields and, often, lower mortgage and borrowing rates over time.
segments.tr: - समय के साथ कम यील्ड और, अक्सर, कम बंधक (mortgage) और उधार दरें।

segments.src: - A more supportive backdrop for stocks, particularly growth-oriented sectors.
segments.tr: - शेयरों के लिए अधिक सहायक पृष्ठभूमि, विशेष रूप से विकास-उन्मुख (growth-oriented) क्षेत्र।

segments.src: **An in-line reading** usually matters less for markets, but it can still shape the tone of Fed commentary.
segments.tr: **उम्मीद के अनुसार रीडिंग** आमतौर पर बाजारों के लिए कम मायने रखती है, लेकिन यह अभी भी फेड की टिप्पणी के लहजे को आकार दे सकती है।

segments.src: Forecasts, known as consensus estimates, are what traders measure surprises against, so the gap between expectation and result is often more important than the number itself.
segments.tr: पूर्वानुमान, जिन्हें आम सहमति अनुमान (consensus estimates) के रूप में जाना जाता है, वे हैं जिनके आधार पर व्यापारी अप्रत्याशित परिवर्तनों को मापते हैं, इसलिए अपेक्षा और परिणाम के बीच का अंतर अक्सर आंकड़े से अधिक महत्वपूर्ण होता है।

segments.src: ## Why the Timing Is Notable
segments.tr: ## समय (Timing) क्यों उल्लेखनीय है

segments.src: The Fed's rate-setting committee meets on a published schedule, and the PCE report lands on its own calendar.
segments.tr: फेड की दर-निर्धारण समिति एक प्रकाशित कार्यक्रम पर मिलती है, और PCE रिपोर्ट अपने स्वयं के कैलेंडर पर आती है।

segments.src: When the data arrives just after a meeting, officials cannot react to it until their next gathering.
segments.tr: जब डेटा किसी बैठक के तुरंत बाद आता है, तो अधिकारी अगली बैठक तक उस पर प्रतिक्रिया नहीं दे सकते हैं।

segments.src: Instead, it feeds into speeches, interviews and updated forecasts, and it can move market pricing for the following meeting.
segments.tr: इसके बजाय, यह भाषणों, साक्षात्कारों और अद्यतन पूर्वानुमानों को प्रभावित करता है, और यह निम्नलिखित बैठक के लिए बाजार मूल्य निर्धारण को बदल सकता है।

segments.src: The approach of Election Day adds another layer of attention, but the Fed is designed to operate independently and says it bases decisions on economic data and its dual mandate of maximum employment and stable prices.
segments.tr: चुनाव के दिन का नज़दीक आना ध्यान का एक और स्तर जोड़ता है, लेकिन फेड को स्वतंत्र रूप से काम करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है और इसका कहना है कि यह आर्थिक डेटा और अधिकतम रोजगार तथा स्थिर कीमतों के अपने दोहरे जनादेश पर निर्णय आधारित करता है।

segments.src: Investors should be wary of assuming that policy follows the political calendar.
segments.tr: निवेशकों को यह मानने से बचना चाहिए कि नीति राजनीतिक कैलेंडर का पालन करती है।

segments.src: ## What to Watch When the Report Arrives
segments.tr: ## रिपोर्ट आने पर क्या देखना है

segments.src: 1. **Core PCE, month over month.** Is momentum cooling or reaccelerating?
segments.tr: 1. **कोर PCE, महीने-दर-महीने।** क्या गति धीमी हो रही है या फिर से तेज हो रही है?

segments.src: 2. **Core PCE, year over year.** How far is it from the 2 percent goal?
segments.tr: 2. **कोर PCE, साल-दर-साल।** यह 2 प्रतिशत के लक्ष्य से कितना दूर है?

segments.src: 3. **Revisions to prior months.** Changes can alter the story of the past quarter.
segments.tr: 3. **पिछली तिमाहियों में संशोधन।** परिवर्तन पिछली तिमाही की कहानी को बदल सकते हैं।

segments.src: 4. **Services excluding housing.** A key gauge of labor-driven price pressure.
segments.tr: 4. **आवास को छोड़कर सेवाएं।** श्रम-संचालित मूल्य दबाव का एक प्रमुख मापक।

segments.src: 5. **Personal income and spending.** Strong consumer demand can keep inflation elevated, while weakening spending may signal slowing growth.
segments.tr: 5. **व्यक्तिगत आय और व्यय।** मजबूत उपभोक्ता मांग मुद्रास्फीति को ऊंचा रख सकती है, जबकि कमजोर खर्च विकास के धीमा होने का संकेत दे सकता है।

segments.src: 6. **Fed speakers.** Their reaction in the days after the release often clarifies how the committee reads the data.
segments.tr: 6. **फेड वक्ता।** विज्ञप्ति के बाद के दिनों में उनकी प्रतिक्रिया अक्सर यह स्पष्ट करती है कि समिति डेटा को कैसे समझती है।

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## मुख्य बात (The Bottom Line)

segments.src: CPI may dominate the headlines, but PCE, and especially core PCE, is the measure closest to the Fed's decision-making.
segments.tr: CPI भले ही सुर्खियों में छाया रहे, लेकिन PCE, और विशेष रूप से कोर PCE, फेड के निर्णय लेने के सबसे करीब का मापक है।

segments.src: Understanding how it is built, and why it can differ from CPI, helps you read market reactions with more context.
segments.tr: यह कैसे बनाया गया है, और यह CPI से क्यों भिन्न हो सकता है, यह समझना आपको अधिक संदर्भ के साथ बाजार की प्रतिक्रियाओं को पढ़ने में मदद करता है।

segments.src: A surprise in either direction will shift expectations for interest rates, but one report is rarely decisive.
segments.tr: किसी भी दिशा में एक अप्रत्याशित आंकड़ा ब्याज दरों की अपेक्षाओं को बदल देगा, लेकिन एक रिपोर्ट शायद ही कभी निर्णायक होती है।

segments.src: The trend across several months tells the more reliable story.
segments.tr: कई महीनों का रुझान अधिक विश्वसनीय कहानी बताता है।

segments.src: Economic data and forecasts are subject to revision, and past market reactions do not guarantee future results.
segments.tr: आर्थिक डेटा और पूर्वानुमान संशोधन के अधीन हैं, और अतीत की बाजार प्रतिक्रियाएं भविष्य के परिणामों की गारंटी नहीं देती हैं।

es.title: El indicador de inflación favorito de la Fed: lo que significa el informe del PCE para las tasas antes del día de las elecciones

segments.src: When people talk about inflation, they usually mean the Consumer Price Index, the monthly report that makes headlines and shows up in everyday conversation.
segments.tr: Cuando la gente habla de inflación, generalmente se refiere al Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC), el informe mensual que ocupa los titulares y aparece en las conversaciones cotidianas.

segments.src: But the Federal Reserve's official 2 percent inflation goal is defined in terms of a different measure: the **Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index**.
segments.tr: Pero el objetivo oficial de inflación del 2 por ciento de la Reserva Federal se define en términos de una medida diferente: el **índice de precios de los Gastos de Consumo Personal (PCE, por sus siglas en inglés)**.

segments.src: With the next PCE reading due shortly after the Fed's latest rate decision, and with Election Day close behind, this is a good moment to understand what the number is, why policymakers prefer it, and how markets tend to interpret a surprise in either direction.
segments.tr: Dado que la próxima lectura del PCE se publicará poco después de la última decisión sobre las tasas de la Fed, y con el día de las elecciones cerca, este es un buen momento para entender qué es este número, por qué los responsables de la política monetaria lo prefieren y cómo los mercados suelen interpretar una sorpresa en cualquier dirección.

segments.src: *Note: Release dates and figures can change.
segments.tr: *Nota: Las fechas de publicación y las cifras pueden cambiar.

segments.src: Check the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) and Federal Reserve calendars for exact timing and the latest data.*
segments.tr: Consulte los calendarios de la Oficina de Análisis Económico (BEA) y de la Reserva Federal para conocer el momento exacto y los datos más recientes.*

segments.src: ## What Is the PCE Price Index?
segments.tr: ## ¿Qué es el índice de precios PCE?

segments.src: The PCE price index is published by the BEA, part of the U.S.
segments.tr: El índice de precios PCE es publicado por la BEA, parte del Departamento de Comercio de EE.

segments.src: Department of Commerce.
segments.tr: UU.

segments.src: It tracks the prices of goods and services that households consume, and it is released alongside the monthly report on personal income and spending.
segments.tr: Realiza un seguimiento de los precios de los bienes y servicios que consumen los hogares, y se publica junto con el informe mensual sobre ingresos y gastos personales.

segments.src: The Fed has used PCE inflation as its formal yardstick since 2012, when it set a long-run goal of 2 percent annual inflation.
segments.tr: La Fed ha utilizado la inflación PCE como su vara de medir formal desde 2012, cuando estableció un objetivo a largo plazo de una inflación anual del 2 por ciento.

segments.src: In practice, the committee looks at many indicators, but PCE is the one its target is written around.
segments.tr: En la práctica, el comité analiza muchos indicadores, pero el PCE es aquel en torno al cual está redactado su objetivo.

segments.src: ## How PCE Differs From CPI
segments.tr: ## En qué se diferencia el PCE del IPC

segments.src: Both indexes measure price changes, but they are built differently.
segments.tr: Ambos índices miden los cambios de precios, pero están construidos de manera diferente.

segments.src: Several differences matter:
segments.tr: Varias diferencias son importantes:

segments.src: - **Scope.** CPI reflects out-of-pocket spending by urban consumers. PCE covers a broader range of spending, including purchases made on behalf of households, such as employer-paid health insurance and medical care covered by Medicare and Medicaid.
segments.tr: - **Alcance.** El IPC refleja el gasto de bolsillo de los consumidores urbanos. El PCE cubre una gama más amplia de gastos, incluidas las compras realizadas en nombre de los hogares, como el seguro médico pagado por el empleador y la atención médica cubierta por Medicare y Medicaid.

segments.src: - **Weights.** Housing makes up a larger share of CPI than of PCE. Because shelter costs often move slowly and can stay elevated, this difference can push the two measures apart.
segments.tr: - **Ponderaciones.** La vivienda representa una mayor parte del IPC que del PCE. Debido a que los costos de la vivienda a menudo se mueven lentamente y pueden permanecer elevados, esta diferencia puede separar ambas medidas.

segments.src: - **Formula.** CPI is based on a fixed basket that is updated periodically. PCE uses a method that adjusts for the way consumers shift their spending when relative prices change. If beef gets expensive and shoppers buy more chicken, PCE captures that substitution more fully.
segments.tr: - **Fórmula.** El IPC se basa en una cesta fija que se actualiza periódicamente. El PCE utiliza un método que se ajusta a la forma en que los consumidores cambian sus gastos cuando cambian los precios relativos. Si la carne de res se vuelve cara y los compradores compran más pollo, el PCE captura esa sustitución de manera más completa.

segments.src: - **Revisions.** CPI is rarely revised after release. PCE can be revised, sometimes for several months and occasionally for years, as better source data arrive.
segments.tr: - **Revisiones.** El IPC rara vez se revisa después de su publicación. El PCE puede revisarse, a veces durante varios meses y ocasionalmente durante años, a medida que llegan mejores datos de origen.

segments.src: The result is that PCE inflation has often come in somewhat lower than CPI inflation over time, though the gap varies and can reverse.
segments.tr: El resultado es que la inflación PCE a menudo ha sido algo menor que la inflación del IPC con el paso del tiempo, aunque la brecha varía y puede invertirse.

segments.src: ## Why Core PCE Matters Most
segments.tr: ## Por qué el PCE subyacente es el que más importa

segments.src: Headline PCE includes everything, including food and energy.
segments.tr: El PCE general incluye todo, incluidos los alimentos y la energía.

segments.src: Those categories are volatile, driven by weather, geopolitics and supply disruptions that central banks cannot easily influence with interest rates.
segments.tr: Esas categorías son volátiles, impulsadas por el clima, la geopolítica y las interrupciones del suministro que los bancos centrales no pueden influir fácilmente con las tasas de interés.

segments.src: **Core PCE** removes food and energy.
segments.tr: **El PCE subyacente** elimina los alimentos y la energía.

segments.src: Many policymakers view it as a cleaner signal of underlying inflation trends and a better guide to where overall inflation is heading over the next year or so.
segments.tr: Muchos responsables de la política monetaria lo consideran una señal más clara de las tendencias de inflación subyacentes y una mejor guía sobre hacia dónde se dirige la inflación general durante el próximo año aproximadamente.

segments.src: That is why you will often hear Fed officials emphasize the core figure in speeches and press conferences, even when the headline number gets the attention.
segments.tr: Es por eso que a menudo escuchará a los funcionarios de la Fed enfatizar la cifra subyacente en discursos y conferencias de prensa, incluso cuando la cifra general recibe la atención.

segments.src: Two other details are worth knowing:
segments.tr: Vale la pena conocer otros dos detalles:

segments.src: - **Month-over-month readings** show momentum. A string of small monthly increases can add up to an annual rate well above target.
segments.tr: - **Las lecturas mes a mes** muestran el impulso. Una serie de pequeños aumentos mensuales pueden sumar una tasa anual muy por encima del objetivo.

segments.src: - **Year-over-year readings** show the broader trend but can be distorted by what happened twelve months earlier, known as base effects.
segments.tr: - **Las lecturas año tras año** muestran la tendencia más amplia, pero pueden verse distorsionadas por lo que sucedió doce meses antes, lo que se conoce como efectos base.

segments.src: Some analysts also watch "supercore" inflation, which looks at services excluding housing, because it is closely tied to wages and labor market conditions.
segments.tr: Algunos analistas también observan la inflación "supercore" (super subyacente), que analiza los servicios excluyendo la vivienda, porque está estrechamente vinculada a los salarios y las condiciones del mercado laboral.

segments.src: ## What a Hot or Cool Number Could Mean for Rates
segments.tr: ## Qué podría significar un número alto o bajo para las tasas

segments.src: The Fed does not set policy based on one report.
segments.tr: La Fed no establece su política basándose en un solo informe.

segments.src: Still, each reading nudges expectations, and markets often react quickly.
segments.tr: Aun así, cada lectura modifica las expectativas y los mercados suelen reaccionar rápidamente.

segments.src: **A hotter-than-expected reading** could suggest that price pressures are proving stubborn.
segments.tr: **Una lectura más alta de lo esperado** podría sugerir que las presiones sobre los precios están resultando persistentes.

segments.src: Possible effects include:
segments.tr: Los posibles efectos incluyen:

segments.src: - Greater caution among policymakers about cutting rates further, or a longer pause.
segments.tr: - Mayor cautela entre los responsables de la política monetaria sobre recortar más las tasas, o una pausa más larga.

segments.src: - Higher Treasury yields as investors scale back bets on near-term cuts.
segments.tr: - Mayores rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro a medida que los inversores reducen sus apuestas sobre recortes a corto plazo.

segments.src: - A firmer U.S. dollar and, at times, pressure on rate-sensitive stocks such as technology and real estate.
segments.tr: - Un dólar estadounidense más firme y, a veces, presión sobre las acciones sensibles a las tasas, como las de tecnología y bienes raíces.

segments.src: **A cooler-than-expected reading** could strengthen the case that inflation is moving toward target.
segments.tr: **Una lectura más baja de lo esperado** podría fortalecer el argumento de que la inflación se está moviendo hacia el objetivo.

segments.src: Possible effects include:
segments.tr: Los posibles efectos incluyen:

segments.src: - More room for the Fed to ease policy if the labor market is softening.
segments.tr: - Más margen para que la Fed flexibilice la política si el mercado laboral se está debilitando.

segments.src: - Lower yields and, often, lower mortgage and borrowing rates over time.
segments.tr: - Rendimientos más bajos y, a menudo, tasas hipotecarias y de endeudamiento más bajas con el tiempo.

segments.src: - A more supportive backdrop for stocks, particularly growth-oriented sectors.
segments.tr: - Un entorno más favorable para las acciones, particularmente para los sectores orientados al crecimiento.

segments.src: **An in-line reading** usually matters less for markets, but it can still shape the tone of Fed commentary.
segments.tr: **Una lectura en línea con lo esperado** suele importar menos para los mercados, pero aún puede dar forma al tono de los comentarios de la Fed.

segments.src: Forecasts, known as consensus estimates, are what traders measure surprises against, so the gap between expectation and result is often more important than the number itself.
segments.tr: Los pronósticos, conocidos como estimaciones de consenso, son contra los que los operadores miden las sorpresas, por lo que la brecha entre la expectativa y el resultado suele ser más importante que el número en sí.

segments.src: ## Why the Timing Is Notable
segments.tr: ## Por qué el momento es notable

segments.src: The Fed's rate-setting committee meets on a published schedule, and the PCE report lands on its own calendar.
segments.tr: El comité de fijación de tasas de la Fed se reúne según un calendario publicado, y el informe del PCE llega según su propio calendario.

segments.src: When the data arrives just after a meeting, officials cannot react to it until their next gathering.
segments.tr: Cuando los datos llegan justo después de una reunión, los funcionarios no pueden reaccionar ante ellos hasta su próxima reunión.

segments.src: Instead, it feeds into speeches, interviews and updated forecasts, and it can move market pricing for the following meeting.
segments.tr: En cambio, se incorporan a discursos, entrevistas y pronósticos actualizados, y pueden mover la valoración del mercado para la siguiente reunión.

segments.src: The approach of Election Day adds another layer of attention, but the Fed is designed to operate independently and says it bases decisions on economic data and its dual mandate of maximum employment and stable prices.
segments.tr: La proximidad del día de las elecciones añade otra capa de atención, pero la Fed está diseñada para operar de forma independiente y afirma que basa sus decisiones en los datos económicos y en su doble mandato de máximo empleo y precios estables.

segments.src: Investors should be wary of assuming that policy follows the political calendar.
segments.tr: Los inversores deben tener cuidado de asumir que la política sigue el calendario político.

segments.src: ## What to Watch When the Report Arrives
segments.tr: ## Qué observar cuando llegue el informe

segments.src: 1. **Core PCE, month over month.** Is momentum cooling or reaccelerating?
segments.tr: 1. **PCE subyacente, mes a mes.** ¿El impulso se está enfriando o volviendo a acelerar?

segments.src: 2. **Core PCE, year over year.** How far is it from the 2 percent goal?
segments.tr: 2. **PCE subyacente, año tras año.** ¿Qué tan lejos está del objetivo del 2 por ciento?

segments.src: 3. **Revisions to prior months.** Changes can alter the story of the past quarter.
segments.tr: 3. **Revisiones de meses anteriores.** Los cambios pueden alterar la historia del trimestre pasado.

segments.src: 4. **Services excluding housing.** A key gauge of labor-driven price pressure.
segments.tr: 4. **Servicios excluyendo vivienda.** Un indicador clave de la presión sobre los precios impulsada por la mano de obra.

segments.src: 5. **Personal income and spending.** Strong consumer demand can keep inflation elevated, while weakening spending may signal slowing growth.
segments.tr: 5. **Ingresos y gastos personales.** Una fuerte demanda de los consumidores puede mantener la inflación elevada, mientras que un gasto debilitado puede indicar una desaceleración del crecimiento.

segments.src: 6. **Fed speakers.** Their reaction in the days after the release often clarifies how the committee reads the data.
segments.tr: 6. **Oradores de la Fed.** Su reacción en los días posteriores a la publicación a menudo aclara cómo interpreta el comité los datos.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.src: CPI may dominate the headlines, but PCE, and especially core PCE, is the measure closest to the Fed's decision-making.
segments.tr: El IPC puede dominar los titulares, pero el PCE, y especialmente el PCE subyacente, es la medida más cercana a la toma de decisiones de la Fed.

segments.src: Understanding how it is built, and why it can differ from CPI, helps you read market reactions with more context.
segments.tr: Comprender cómo se construye y por qué puede diferir del IPC le ayuda a leer las reacciones del mercado con más contexto.

segments.src: A surprise in either direction will shift expectations for interest rates, but one report is rarely decisive.
segments.tr: Una sorpresa en cualquier dirección cambiará las expectativas sobre las tasas de interés, pero un informe rara vez es decisivo.

segments.src: The trend across several months tells the more reliable story.
segments.tr: La tendencia a lo largo de varios meses cuenta la historia más confiable.

ar.title: مقياس التضخم المفضل لدى الاحتياطي الفيدرالي: ماذا يعني تقرير نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي (PCE) لأسعار الفائدة قبل يوم الانتخابات

segments.src: When people talk about inflation, they usually mean the Consumer Price Index, the monthly report that makes headlines and shows up in everyday conversation.
segments.tr: عندما يتحدث الناس عن التضخم، فإنهم عادة ما يقصدون مؤشر أسعار المستهلك (CPI)، وهو التقرير الشهري الذي يتصدر العناوين ويظهر في المحادثات اليومية.

segments.src: But the Federal Reserve's official 2 percent inflation goal is defined in terms of a different measure: the **Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index**.
segments.tr: لكن هدف التضخم الرسمي للاحتياطي الفيدرالي البالغ 2 بالمئة يتم تحديده بناءً على مقياس مختلف: **مؤشر أسعار نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي (PCE)**.

segments.src: With the next PCE reading due shortly after the Fed's latest rate decision, and with Election Day close behind, this is a good moment to understand what the number is, why policymakers prefer it, and how markets tend to interpret a surprise in either direction.
segments.tr: مع صدور قراءة مؤشر نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي التالية بعد وقت قصير من قرار الاحتياطي الفيدرالي الأخير بشأن أسعار الفائدة، ومع اقتراب يوم الانتخابات، فهذه لحظة جيدة لفهم ماهية هذا الرقم، ولماذا يفضله صناع السياسات، وكيف تميل الأسواق إلى تفسير أي مفاجأة في أي من الاتجاهين.

segments.src: *Note: Release dates and figures can change.
segments.tr: *ملاحظة: تواريخ الإصدار والأرقام قابلة للتغيير.

segments.src: Check the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) and Federal Reserve calendars for exact timing and the latest data.*
segments.tr: تحقق من تقاويم مكتب التحليل الاقتصادي (BEA) والاحتياطي الفيدرالي لمعرفة التوقيت الدقيق وأحدث البيانات.*

segments.src: ## What Is the PCE Price Index?
segments.tr: ## ما هو مؤشر أسعار نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي (PCE)؟

segments.src: The PCE price index is published by the BEA, part of the U.S.
segments.tr: يتم نشر مؤشر أسعار نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي من قبل مكتب التحليل الاقتصادي (BEA)، وهو جزء من وزارة التجارة الأمريكية.

segments.src: Department of Commerce.
segments.tr: وزارة التجارة.

segments.src: It tracks the prices of goods and services that households consume, and it is released alongside the monthly report on personal income and spending.
segments.tr: وهو يتتبع أسعار السلع والخدمات التي تستهلكها الأسر، ويصدر جنباً إلى جنب مع التقرير الشهري عن الدخل والإنفاق الشخصي.

segments.src: The Fed has used PCE inflation as its formal yardstick since 2012, when it set a long-run goal of 2 percent annual inflation.
segments.tr: يستخدم الاحتياطي الفيدرالي تضخم نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي كمعياره الرسمي منذ عام 2012، عندما حدد هدفاً طويل الأجل للتضخم السنوي بنسبة 2 بالمئة.

segments.src: In practice, the committee looks at many indicators, but PCE is the one its target is written around.
segments.tr: من الناحية العملية، تنظر اللجنة إلى العديد من المؤشرات، لكن نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي هو المؤشر الذي كُتب هدفه حوله.

segments.src: ## How PCE Differs From CPI
segments.tr: ## كيف يختلف مؤشر نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي عن مؤشر أسعار المستهلك؟

segments.src: Both indexes measure price changes, but they are built differently.
segments.tr: كلا المؤشرين يقيسان تغيرات الأسعار، لكنهما مبنيان بطرق مختلفة.

segments.src: Several differences matter:
segments.tr: هناك عدة اختلافات مهمة:

segments.src: - **Scope.** CPI reflects out-of-pocket spending by urban consumers. PCE covers a broader range of spending, including purchases made on behalf of households, such as employer-paid health insurance and medical care covered by Medicare and Medicaid.
segments.tr: - **النطاق.** يعكس مؤشر أسعار المستهلك (CPI) الإنفاق من الجيب للمستهلكين في المناطق الحضرية. بينما يغطي مؤشر نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي (PCE) نطاقاً أوسع من الإنفاق، بما في ذلك المشتريات التي تتم نيابة عن الأسر، مثل التأمين الصحي الذي يدفع صاحب العمل تكاليفه والرعاية الطبية التي يغطيها برنامجا ميديكير وميديكيد.

segments.src: - **Weights.** Housing makes up a larger share of CPI than of PCE. Because shelter costs often move slowly and can stay elevated, this difference can push the two measures apart.
segments.tr: - **الأوزان.** يشكل الإسكان حصة أكبر في مؤشر أسعار المستهلك مقارنة بمؤشر نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي. ولأن تكاليف المأوى غالباً ما تتحرك ببطء ويمكن أن تظل مرتفعة، فإن هذا الاختلاف يمكن أن يدفع المقياسين بعيداً عن بعضهما البعض.

segments.src: - **Formula.** CPI is based on a fixed basket that is updated periodically. PCE uses a method that adjusts for the way consumers shift their spending when relative prices change. If beef gets expensive and shoppers buy more chicken, PCE captures that substitution more fully.
segments.tr: - **الصيغة.** يعتمد مؤشر أسعار المستهلك على سلة ثابتة يتم تحديثها دورياً. بينما يستخدم مؤشر نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي طريقة تعدل الطريقة التي يغير بها المستهلكون إنفاقهم عندما تتغير الأسعار النسبية. إذا أصبح لحم البقر باهظ الثمن واشترى المتسوقون المزيد من الدجاج، فإن مؤشر نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي يلتقط هذا الاستبدال بشكل أكثر اكتمالاً.

segments.src: - **Revisions.** CPI is rarely revised after release. PCE can be revised, sometimes for several months and occasionally for years, as better source data arrive.
segments.tr: - **المراجعات.** نادراً ما يتم تعديل مؤشر أسعار المستهلك بعد إصداره. بينما يمكن تعديل مؤشر نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي، أحياناً لعدة أشهر وأحياناً لسنوات، مع وصول بيانات مصدر أفضل.

segments.src: The result is that PCE inflation has often come in somewhat lower than CPI inflation over time, though the gap varies and can reverse.
segments.tr: والنتيجة هي أن تضخم نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي غالباً ما يكون أقل إلى حد ما من تضخم مؤشر أسعار المستهلك بمرور الوقت، على الرغم من أن الفجوة تختلف ويمكن أن تنعكس.

segments.src: ## Why Core PCE Matters Most
segments.tr: ## لماذا يعتبر مؤشر نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي الأساسي هو الأكثر أهمية

segments.src: Headline PCE includes everything, including food and energy.
segments.tr: يشمل مؤشر نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي العام كل شيء، بما في ذلك الغذاء والطاقة.

segments.src: Those categories are volatile, driven by weather, geopolitics and supply disruptions that central banks cannot easily influence with interest rates.
segments.tr: هذه الفئات متقلبة، وتتأثر بالطقس والجيوسياسة واضطرابات الإمدادات التي لا تستطيع البنوك المركزية التأثير عليها بسهولة بأسعار الفائدة.

segments.src: **Core PCE** removes food and energy.
segments.tr: **مؤشر نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي الأساسي** يستبعد الغذاء والطاقة.

segments.src: Many policymakers view it as a cleaner signal of underlying inflation trends and a better guide to where overall inflation is heading over the next year or so.
segments.tr: ينظر إليه العديد من صناع السياسات على أنه إشارة أكثر نقاءً لاتجاهات التضخم الأساسية ودليل أفضل على المسار الذي يتجه إليه التضخم العام خلال العام المقبل أو نحو ذلك.

segments.src: That is why you will often hear Fed officials emphasize the core figure in speeches and press conferences, even when the headline number gets the attention.
segments.tr: ولهذا السبب ستسمع غالباً مسؤولي الاحتياطي الفيدرالي يؤكدون على الرقم الأساسي في الخطابات والمؤتمرات الصحفية، حتى عندما يحظى الرقم العام بالاهتمام.

segments.src: Two other details are worth knowing:
segments.tr: هناك تفصيلان آخران يستحقان المعرفة:

segments.src: - **Month-over-month readings** show momentum. A string of small monthly increases can add up to an annual rate well above target.
segments.tr: - **القراءات الشهرية** تظهر الزخم. يمكن أن تتراكم سلسلة من الزيادات الشهرية الصغيرة لتصل إلى معدل سنوي أعلى بكثير من المستهدف.

segments.src: - **Year-over-year readings** show the broader trend but can be distorted by what happened twelve months earlier, known as base effects.
segments.tr: - **القراءات السنوية** تظهر الاتجاه الأوسع ولكن يمكن أن تتشوه بسبب ما حدث قبل اثني عشر شهراً، وهو ما يعرف بتأثيرات الأساس.

segments.src: Some analysts also watch "supercore" inflation, which looks at services excluding housing, because it is closely tied to wages and labor market conditions.
segments.tr: يراقب بعض المحللين أيضاً تضخم "النواة الفائقة" (supercore)، الذي ينظر إلى الخدمات باستثناء الإسكان، لأنه مرتبط ارتباطاً وثيقاً بالأجور وظروف سوق العمل.

segments.src: ## Why the Timing Is Notable
segments.tr: ## لماذا التوقيت جدير بالملاحظة

segments.src: ## What to Watch When the Report Arrives
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يجب مراقبته عند وصول التقرير

segments.src: 1. **Core PCE, month over month.** Is momentum cooling or reaccelerating?

fr.title: La jauge d'inflation préférée de la Fed : ce que le rapport PCE signifie pour les taux avant le jour des élections

segments.src: When people talk about inflation, they usually mean the Consumer Price Index, the monthly report that makes headlines and shows up in everyday conversation.
segments.tr: Lorsque les gens parlent d'inflation, ils font généralement référence à l'indice des prix à la consommation, le rapport mensuel qui fait les gros titres et s'invite dans les conversations quotidiennes.

segments.src: But the Federal Reserve's official 2 percent inflation goal is defined in terms of a different measure: the **Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index**.
segments.tr: Mais l'objectif d'inflation officiel de la Réserve fédérale, fixé à 2 pour cent, est défini à partir d'une autre mesure : l'**indice des prix des dépenses de consommation personnelle (PCE)**.

segments.src: With the next PCE reading due shortly after the Fed's latest rate decision, and with Election Day close behind, this is a good moment to understand what the number is, why policymakers prefer it, and how markets tend to interpret a surprise in either direction.
segments.tr: Alors que la prochaine publication du PCE est attendue peu après la dernière décision de la Fed sur les taux, et que le jour des élections approche, c'est le moment idéal pour comprendre ce que représente ce chiffre, pourquoi les décideurs politiques le privilégient et comment les marchés ont tendance à interpréter une surprise dans un sens ou dans l'autre.

segments.src: *Note: Release dates and figures can change.
segments.tr: *Remarque : Les dates de publication et les chiffres peuvent changer.

segments.src: Check the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) and Federal Reserve calendars for exact timing and the latest data.*
segments.tr: Consultez les calendriers du Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) et de la Réserve fédérale pour connaître le calendrier exact et les dernières données.*

segments.src: ## What Is the PCE Price Index?
segments.tr: ## Qu'est-ce que l'indice des prix PCE ?

segments.src: The PCE price index is published by the BEA, part of the U.S.
segments.tr: L'indice des prix PCE est publié par le BEA, qui fait partie du département du

segments.src: Department of Commerce.
segments.tr: Commerce des États-Unis.

segments.src: It tracks the prices of goods and services that households consume, and it is released alongside the monthly report on personal income and spending.
segments.tr: Il suit les prix des biens et services consommés par les ménages, et il est publié en même temps que le rapport mensuel sur les revenus et les dépenses des particuliers.

segments.src: The Fed has used PCE inflation as its formal yardstick since 2012, when it set a long-run goal of 2 percent annual inflation.
segments.tr: La Fed utilise l'inflation PCE comme étalon officiel depuis 2012, date à laquelle elle a fixé un objectif à long terme de 2 pour cent d'inflation annuelle.

segments.src: In practice, the committee looks at many indicators, but PCE is the one its target is written around.
segments.tr: En pratique, le comité examine de nombreux indicateurs, mais le PCE est celui autour duquel son objectif est rédigé.

segments.src: ## How PCE Differs From CPI
segments.tr: ## En quoi le PCE diffère du CPI

segments.src: Both indexes measure price changes, but they are built differently.
segments.tr: Ces deux indices mesurent l'évolution des prix, mais ils sont construits différemment.

segments.src: Several differences matter:
segments.tr: Plusieurs différences importent :

segments.src: - **Scope.** CPI reflects out-of-pocket spending by urban consumers. PCE covers a broader range of spending, including purchases made on behalf of households, such as employer-paid health insurance and medical care covered by Medicare and Medicaid.
segments.tr: - **Portée.** Le CPI reflète les dépenses directes des consommateurs urbains. Le PCE couvre un éventail plus large de dépenses, y compris les achats effectués au nom des ménages, tels que l'assurance maladie payée par l'employeur et les soins médicaux couverts par Medicare et Medicaid.

segments.src: - **Weights.** Housing makes up a larger share of CPI than of PCE. Because shelter costs often move slowly and can stay elevated, this difference can push the two measures apart.
segments.tr: - **Pondérations.** Le logement représente une part plus importante du CPI que du PCE. Comme les coûts du logement évoluent souvent lentement et peuvent rester élevés, cette différence peut éloigner les deux mesures.

segments.src: - **Formula.** CPI is based on a fixed basket that is updated periodically. PCE uses a method that adjusts for the way consumers shift their spending when relative prices change. If beef gets expensive and shoppers buy more chicken, PCE captures that substitution more fully.
segments.tr: - **Formule.** Le CPI repose sur un panier fixe mis à jour périodiquement. Le PCE utilise une méthode qui s'ajuste à la manière dont les consommateurs modifient leurs dépenses lorsque les prix relatifs changent. Si le bœuf devient cher et que les acheteurs achètent plus de poulet, le PCE saisit cette substitution de manière plus complète.

segments.src: - **Revisions.** CPI is rarely revised after release. PCE can be revised, sometimes for several months and occasionally for years, as better source data arrive.
segments.tr: - **Révisions.** Le CPI est rarement révisé après sa publication. Le PCE peut être révisé, parfois pendant plusieurs mois et occasionnellement pendant des années, à mesure que de meilleures données sources arrivent.

segments.src: The result is that PCE inflation has often come in somewhat lower than CPI inflation over time, though the gap varies and can reverse.
segments.tr: Il en résulte que l'inflation PCE s'est souvent avérée quelque peu inférieure à l'inflation du CPI au fil du temps, bien que l'écart varie et puisse s'inverser.

segments.src: ## Why Core PCE Matters Most
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le PCE core est le plus important

segments.src: Headline PCE includes everything, including food and energy.
segments.tr: Le PCE global (headline) comprend tout, y compris l'alimentation et l'énergie.

segments.src: Those categories are volatile, driven by weather, geopolitics and supply disruptions that central banks cannot easily influence with interest rates.
segments.tr: Ces catégories sont volatiles, portées par la météo, la géopolitique et les perturbations de la chaîne d'approvisionnement que les banques centrales ne peuvent pas facilement influencer avec les taux d'intérêt.

segments.src: **Core PCE** removes food and energy.
segments.tr: **Le PCE core** élimine l'alimentation et l'énergie.

segments.src: Many policymakers view it as a cleaner signal of underlying inflation trends and a better guide to where overall inflation is heading over the next year or so.
segments.tr: De nombreux décideurs politiques le considèrent comme un signal plus clair des tendances de l'inflation sous-jacente et un meilleur guide de l'orientation de l'inflation globale au cours de l'année à venir environ.

segments.src: That is why you will often hear Fed officials emphasize the core figure in speeches and press conferences, even when the headline number gets the attention.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi vous entendrez souvent des responsables de la Fed souligner le chiffre core dans leurs discours et conférences de presse, même lorsque le chiffre global attire l'attention.

segments.src: Two other details are worth knowing:
segments.tr: Deux autres détails méritent d'être connus :

segments.src: - **Month-over-month readings** show momentum. A string of small monthly increases can add up to an annual rate well above target.
segments.tr: - **Les lectures d'un mois sur l'autre** montrent la dynamique. Une série de petites hausses mensuelles peut s'additionner pour atteindre un taux annuel bien supérieur à l'objectif.

segments.src: - **Year-over-year readings** show the broader trend but can be distorted by what happened twelve months earlier, known as base effects.
segments.tr: - **Les lectures d'une année sur l'autre** montrent la tendance globale mais peuvent être faussées par ce qui s'est passé douze mois auparavant, ce que l'on appelle les effets de base.

segments.src: Some analysts also watch "supercore" inflation, which looks at services excluding housing, because it is closely tied to wages and labor market conditions.
segments.tr: Certains analystes surveillent également l'inflation « supercore », qui examine les services hors logement, car elle est étroitement liée aux salaires et aux conditions du marché du travail.

segments.src: ## What a Hot or Cool Number Could Mean for Rates
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'un chiffre élevé ou bas pourrait signifier pour les taux

segments.src: The Fed does not set policy based on one report.
segments.tr: La Fed ne fixe pas sa politique sur la base d'un seul rapport.

segments.src: Still, each reading nudges expectations, and markets often react quickly.
segments.tr: Néanmoins, chaque lecture modifie les attentes, et les marchés réagissent souvent rapidement.

segments.src: **A hotter-than-expected reading** could suggest that price pressures are proving stubborn.
segments.tr: **Une lecture plus forte que prévu** pourrait suggérer que les pressions sur les prix s'avèrent tenaces.

segments.src: Possible effects include:
segments.tr: Les effets possibles incluent :

segments.src: - Greater caution among policymakers about cutting rates further, or a longer pause.
segments.tr: - Une plus grande prudence parmi les décideurs politiques quant à une nouvelle baisse des taux, ou une pause plus longue.

segments.src: - Higher Treasury yields as investors scale back bets on near-term cuts.
segments.tr: - Des rendements du Trésor plus élevés alors que les investisseurs réduisent leurs paris sur des baisses à court terme.

segments.src: - A firmer U.S. dollar and, at times, pressure on rate-sensitive stocks such as technology and real estate.
segments.tr: - Un dollar américain plus ferme et, parfois, une pression sur les actions sensibles aux taux telles que la technologie et l'immobilier.

segments.src: **A cooler-than-expected reading** could strengthen the case that inflation is moving toward target.
segments.tr: **Une lecture plus faible que prévu** pourrait renforcer l'argument selon lequel l'inflation se dirige vers l'objectif.

segments.src: Possible effects include:
segments.tr: Les effets possibles incluent :

segments.src: - More room for the Fed to ease policy if the labor market is softening.
segments.tr: - Plus de marge de manœuvre pour la Fed pour assouplir sa politique si le marché du travail s'assouplit.

segments.src: - Lower yields and, often, lower mortgage and borrowing rates over time.
segments.tr: - Des rendements plus bas et, souvent, des taux hypothécaires et d'emprunt plus bas au fil du temps.

segments.src: - A more supportive backdrop for stocks, particularly growth-oriented sectors.
segments.tr: - Un contexte plus favorable pour les actions, en particulier les secteurs orientés vers la croissance.

segments.src: **An in-line reading** usually matters less for markets, but it can still shape the tone of Fed commentary.
segments.tr: **Une lecture conforme aux attentes** compte généralement moins pour les marchés, mais elle peut tout de même façonner le ton des commentaires de la Fed.

segments.src: Forecasts, known as consensus estimates, are what traders measure surprises against, so the gap between expectation and result is often more important than the number itself.
segments.tr: Les prévisions, connues sous le nom d'estimations consensuelles, sont ce par rapport à quoi les traders mesurent les surprises, de sorte que l'écart entre l'attente et le résultat est souvent plus important que le chiffre lui-même.

segments.src: ## Why the Timing Is Notable
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le calendrier est remarquable

segments.src: The Fed's rate-setting committee meets on a published schedule, and the PCE report lands on its own calendar.
segments.tr: Le comité de fixation des taux de la Fed se réunit selon un calendrier publié, et le rapport PCE arrive selon son propre calendrier.

segments.src: When the data arrives just after a meeting, officials cannot react to it until their next gathering.
segments.tr: Lorsque les données arrivent juste après une réunion, les responsables ne peuvent pas y réagir avant leur prochain rassemblement.

segments.src: Instead, it feeds into speeches, interviews and updated forecasts, and it can move market pricing for the following meeting.
segments.tr: Au lieu de cela, il alimente les discours, les entrevues et les prévisions mises à jour, et il peut déplacer la tarification du marché pour la réunion suivante.

segments.src: The approach of Election Day adds another layer of attention, but the Fed is designed to operate independently and says it bases decisions on economic data and its dual mandate of maximum employment and stable prices.
segments.tr: L'approche du jour des élections ajoute une autre couche d'attention, mais la Fed est conçue pour fonctionner de manière indépendante et affirme qu'elle fonde ses décisions sur les données économiques et son double mandat d'emploi maximal et de prix stables.

segments.src: Investors should be wary of assuming that policy follows the political calendar.
segments.tr: Les investisseurs doivent se méfier de supposer que la politique suit le calendrier politique.

segments.src: ## What to Watch When the Report Arrives
segments.tr: ## À quoi faire attention lors de l'arrivée du rapport

segments.src: 1. **Core PCE, month over month.** Is momentum cooling or reaccelerating?
segments.tr: 1. **PCE core, d'un mois sur l'autre.** La dynamique ralentit-elle ou réaccélère-t-elle ?

segments.src: 2. **Core PCE, year over year.** How far is it from the 2 percent goal?
segments.tr: 2. **PCE core, d'une année sur l'autre.** À quelle distance se trouve-t-il de l'objectif de 2 pour cent ?

segments.src: 3. **Revisions to prior months.** Changes can alter the story of the past quarter.
segments.tr: 3. **Révisions des mois précédents.** Les changements peuvent modifier l'histoire du trimestre écoulé.

segments.src: 4. **Services excluding housing.** A key gauge of labor-driven price pressure.
segments.tr: 4. **Services hors logement.** Une jauge clé de la pression sur les prix induite par le travail.

segments.src: 5. **Personal income and spending.** Strong consumer demand can keep inflation elevated, while weakening spending may signal slowing growth.
segments.tr: 5. **Revenu et dépenses des particuliers.** Une forte demande des consommateurs peut maintenir l'inflation à un niveau élevé, tandis qu'un affaiblissement des dépenses peut signaler un ralentissement de la croissance.

segments.src: 6. **Fed speakers.** Their reaction in the days after the release often clarifies how the committee reads the data.
segments.tr: 6. **Orateurs de la Fed.** Leur réaction dans les jours suivant la publication clarifie souvent la manière dont le comité lit les données.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: CPI may dominate the headlines, but PCE, and especially core PCE, is the measure closest to the Fed's decision-making.
segments.tr: Le CPI domine peut-être les gros titres, mais le PCE, et en particulier le PCE core, est la mesure la plus proche de la prise de décision de la Fed.

segments.src: Understanding how it is built, and why it can differ from CPI, helps you read market reactions with more context.

segments.tr: Une surprise dans un sens ou dans l'autre modifiera les attentes en matière de taux d'intérêt, mais un seul rapport est rarement décisif.
